metadata.title: Micron Stock Faces Threat From China’s YMTC. Why SK Hynix Could Be Hit Harder.<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Micron Stock Faces Big Threat From China’s YMTC. Why SK Hynix Could Be Hit Harder.
Chinese companies are gunning hard for the memory-chip market. It’s a risk for Micron Technology but probably more of one for its South Korean rivals SK Hynix and Samsung Electronics.
